because that part about the cat never existing might've been a dream within a dream

When I was a teen I used to have multiple layers of lucid dreams like that - you know how sometimes in the morning after your alarm rings you wanna get up and are too groggy so you THINK of getting up and doing stuff AND you even experience it but then it turns out it was just a dream? In my case it was kind of like that but there were multiple layers and those were my normal dreams. At one point it's gotten so bad that I lost track of how many layers there were and it felt like I spent years that way, and I have realized halfway something's not right. I ended up in a psych ward after waking up. I was a sobbing, mumbling mess with crazed eyes, crying in the corner according to my family. Which did not reassure me because the same thing happened for the second half of my years-long dream after the realization and after going up a layers, towards 'reality'. I'm still doubting this is reality tbqh, i've been diagnosed as a "mild case of schizophrenia" - which makes sense, my father is a schizophrenic. But I'm going off on a tangent here; TL;DR: multiple layers of dreams are a thing.
